transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Ever since the divorce and moving into my own place, I keep forgetting basic things like paying bills and showing up for appointments, even when I write them down. It’s just gotten really hard to keep track of everything lately, and I’m starting to get worried.
Did you experience these difficulties with focus and organization throughout your childhood, or is this a new problem that only started after your divorce?

It has definitely gotten much worse over the last 11 months since my divorce, but it actually goes back to when I was a kid. Even in elementary school, my teachers would write on my report cards that I was smart but kept spacing out, losing worksheets, and forgetting to turn in homework I’d actually finished.
Beyond the focus issues, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of sadness, loss of interest in things you usually enjoy, or changes in your appetite and sleep since the divorce?

No, I haven't really been feeling persistently sad or losing interest in things, and my sleep and appetite have been normal. My main struggle is really just the overwhelming forgetfulness and having such a hard time keeping up with daily tasks and staying focused.
Would you say your difficulty with focus and organization is consistently present in all areas of your life, or does it seem specifically triggered by the stress of your recent life changes?

The recent changes and stress definitely made things a lot worse and harder to manage, but these struggles aren't entirely new. It's really affecting all areas of my life now, both with keeping my home organized and handling my responsibilities at work.
Besides the focus and organizational issues, do you often find yourself feeling restless, needing to be constantly on the go, or acting impulsively without thinking of the consequences?

No, I don't really experience physical restlessness or feel like I need to be constantly on the go, and I don't think I act impulsively. My difficulties are almost entirely about losing focus, forgetting things, and struggling to stay organized.
